findings.title: Docker daemon fault during the listing's container reload echoed to the caller, including the anonymous public link
findings.exploit: A public-link holder requests GET /api/public/playbooks/{token} while the Docker daemon returns 500 on the container inspect (or drops the socket); the catch-all returns the docker-py text with the daemon URL, API version and full container id. The caller cannot cause the fault. Regression: the public route never reloaded at the base.
findings.recommendation: Map any non-NotFound reload failure to a named outcome; never echo exception text on the unauthenticated route.
findings.resolution: fixed in-branch with tests (852fcc4fd): reload failures -> unreachable 503 'Could not read the agent's state' (logged); public catch-all answers a fixed sentence; mutation-proven
